**Troubleshooting app behavior**

I’m figuring out that the library_controller is created in VoidScreen and needs to register when mounted. I wonder if it’s not mounted because of an immersive issue. Maybe the app is showing a loader screen in desktop mode. This could prevent the library from registering fully. I’ll check the logs or possibly look into drive overflows. I think restarting the app might help, using `drive.py restart`. That should ensure everything registers properly!
